blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. is looking forward to welcoming Chinese Premier Li Qiang to Manila for the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit and Related Summits, the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) said. In return, China is anticipating Marcos’ participation in the 33rd Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (Apec) Economic Leaders’ Meeting in Shenzhen. The two leaders’ expected participation in the respective regional summits was discussed during a telephone conversation between Foreign Affairs Secretary Ma.
